 Red Dead Redemption 2 fans are currently having a blast, enjoying all the fun Halloween events currently being offered by Rockstar. However, this isn't the only new downloadable content that gamers who love Arthur Morgan and his Western epic can currently partake in.

 For absolutely free, Red Dead Redemption players can experience their favorite open-world game like never before. This new addition to the 2018 sequel may not come from Rockstar, who are getting ready to release Grand Theft Auto 6, but it should still keep gamers entertained for hours. 
 Red Dead Redemption 2 Gets New Free Download Available Now
 Arthur Morgan in Red Dead Redemption 2 Image via Rockstar 
 Red Dead Redemption 2 has been continuously receiving new updates from Rockstar for close to a decade, primarily via the game's online multiplayer mode , Red Dead Online. However, for just as long, the game's modding community has also been extremely active in working towards elevating the experience. 
 Available to download now from Nexus Mods is the "RDR2 Campaign Co-op mod with unofficial enRage compatibility patch" mod. More than just a simple enhancement to the game, this patch opens up all new ways to enjoy Red Dead Redemption 2. 
 "Play RDR2's story mode with up to 3 friends," the mod's description reads. "The host's world, missions and save are shared: ride together, fight side by side, join mission parties and revive each other.'
 "The host's game runs the server and an in-game browser finds games. Installers on GitHub. Optional unofficial enRage co-op patch. Early access, story mode only."

 The mod's Nexus Mods page highlights features like the ability for multiple players to experience the story of Red Dead Redemption 2 together, "on foot, on horseback, in wagons and coaches, and on trains." It talks of the shared world with townsfolk, animals, enemies, and more matching between players, and the ability for all players to get on missions together and share in the rewards, 
 If a player goes down in this mod, they won't immediately die, as a partner will have the ability to revive them. Each player will see every other player's outfit the same way, and there's no need to set up a server to get this to work, as the host's game runs it and opens the router port itself. 
 The mod is also advertised as being compatible with the optional, unofficial enRage co-op patch. Partners' kill counts can be remembered, enemies will remember which players wronged them, and each player will accordingly receive enRage news and grudge notices meant for them.
 The hardware specifications and installation instructions for the "RDR2 Campaign Co-op mod with unofficial enRage compatibility patch" mod are available on its Nexus Mods page. A Discord channel also exists for Red Dead Redemption 2 fans who need help enjoying it, or who simply want to find others to play it with.
